recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future work group decision wants a separate vestigial code, broader DeviceAssociation status remodeling, or examples that use abandoned, handle that under a new or final follow-up tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-48713 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to expand the DeviceAssociation status terminology with a term for implanted devices that remain in the patient's body but are no longer in use; the final resolution tied the change to FHIR-48532's associationStatus updates and the follow-up comment specified code abandoned with display Abandoned.
initial_application: The change was already applied in commit f09755d231, which added abandoned to source/deviceassociation/codesystem-deviceassociation-association-status.xml. That followed FHIR-48532's commit 2b906e8ba0, which introduced DeviceAssociation.associationStatus and its preferred association-status value set.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini, and DeviceAssociation.associationStatus is listed as an active element. The current StructureDefinition binds associationStatus to the association-status ValueSet, and the ValueSet includes the complete association-status CodeSystem containing abandoned. OO minutes on 2025-10-20 record FHIR-48713 as completed with FHIR-48532 and approved 6-0-0; earlier Devices WGM notes only show the pre-resolution discussion was deferred until related changes were finalized.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active CodeSystem has code abandoned, display Abandoned, and a definition matching the Jira request, and the associated ValueSet composition includes that complete CodeSystem. The existing example lists in descriptions are non-exhaustive, so adding abandoned there would be redundant rather than a necessary semantic fix.

related_jiras.note: Created DeviceAssociation.associationStatus and the preferred association-status value set that FHIR-48713 explicitly completes.
